label: Opening Hook
text: In 1929, a 1513 Ottoman world map turned up in Istanbul, partly copied from a lost map by Christopher Columbus.
title: File:Piri reis world map 01.jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: Compiled in 1513 by Ottoman admiral Piri Reis from about 20 source maps Rediscovered in 1929 in the Topkapi Palace library Piri Reis noted that he used a map drawn by Columbus, which has never been found Claims that it shows ice-free Antarctica are rejected by historians; the southern coast is usually read as a distorted South American coastline Only about a third of the original map survives
title: Beschreibung des Mittelmmeeres und seiner Küstenländer des Piri Reis, von a-Fagir Mehmd Reis Inseln im Mittelmeer mit Städten und Festungen (Europeana, Deutsche Fotothek)
